qwen3.prompt_template: Locate every instance that belongs to the following categories: "{label}". Report bbox coordinates in JSON format.

randomness: GREEDY_NO_SAMPLING; no claim of cross-device bitwise determinism
pass_requires_all: Source-backed absence contract resolved and versioned before any execution; neither current blocker can be waived.
One pinned model load, exactly ten required calls in fixed order, no missing/duplicate/extra calls; every call completes with EOS, not truncation.
Every raw envelope and provenance durably persisted, reread and SHA256/size verified before any parser; complete final artifact audit.
No runtime, storage, provenance, token-boundary or identity error.
Every response parses successfully under the same pinned candidate contract and exact native target label.
Every positive case has exactly as many detections as target instances, with a bijection between prediction centers and target GT boxes; no duplicate assignment or unassigned detection.
Every detection excludes every distractor center; boundaries count as inside.
All four reciprocal swap pairs pass geometry, with prediction-center displacement having the same strict sign as target displacement on each moved axis.
F_multiple preserves both target detections; no select-first, best-box selection, dropping extras or deduplication.
E_absent has zero valid target detections from a successful source-backed empty parse; invalid, blocked, missing, no-match or null is never empty success.
No exact full-image box; every nonempty case has an explicit NO_GIANT human review with reviewer and rationale, reviewing all detections.
All fixed controls and hashes match the pre-execution lock; no changes after observing responses.

verdict_contract.NOT_RUN: Current PREP only; no model result exists.
verdict_contract.BLOCKED: Preflight source/contract/runtime integration unresolved; do not execute or award PASS.
verdict_contract.FAIL: Any mandatory check fails in an authorized future run; never reinterpret historical verdicts.
verdict_contract.PENDING_REVIEW: All automated checks pass but explicit giant-box review is incomplete; never PASS.
verdict_contract.PASS: All mandatory checks and NO_GIANT reviews pass; role remains unchanged until separate Research Lead decision.

raw_audit_contract.raw_failure: Stop; never invoke parser. Preserve any available partial native output and record failure; never fabricate unavailable bytes.

future_runtime_contract.environment_lock: Before execution record exact Python, torch/CUDA, transformers, tokenizers, Pillow, model/processor snapshot hashes, hardware and native adapter source hashes; approve independently before loading.
future_runtime_contract.historical_runners: UNCHANGED; do not pass this plan to either historical gate. PaliGemma historical runner fixes 32 tokens; new integration is required for this prospectively selected 256-token plan.
future_runtime_contract.budget_basis: Prospective common 256-token ceiling for small multi-detection responses; selected without any historical response lengths or new model outputs. No in-run increase.
future_runtime_contract.fan_out: Future fixed hazard queries independent of GT and Call 1; preserve exact native label and all Evidence records per predeclared hazard binding; no implemented hazard mapping or InspecSafe orchestration. Zero-detection conversion remains blocked.

synthetic_generation.regeneration: Byte-exact within pinned generator environment; CLI verifies checked-in manifest and never overwrites mismatching images.
